events.verdict: Dinwiddie (DAL) moves forward into and delivers contact to Avdija's (POR) body, which alters his driving shot attempt.
Grant (POR) legally contests Doncic's (DAL) jump shot attempt.

Sharpe (POR) and Grimes (DAL) both pursue the loose ball and any contact during the rebound is deemed incidental. Sharpe deflects the ball to his teammate Grant (POR) prior to any contact occurring with Doncic (DAL), who goes to the ground on his own accord after the loose ball.
Portland requests, and is granted, a timeout prior to any contact occurring between Washington (DAL) and Grant (POR).
There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that confirms if Grant's (POR) left foot touches the baseline out of bounds during his drive to the basket.
Washington (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position during Grant's (POR) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Avdija (POR) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Grant (POR) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Washington (DAL).
Dinwiddie (DAL) and Avdija (POR) come together at the same spot and the contact is marginal during Avdija's drive to the basket and shot attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Dinwiddie (DAL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Avdija (POR) initiates contact with Dinwiddie that affects his SQBR and the contact from Dinwiddie is in response to the initial illegal contact by Avdija.

Sharpe (POR) falls to the floor on his own as he attempts to change directions. He loses control of the ball while going to the ground and any contact by Doncic (DAL) or Grimes (DAL) in pursuit of the loose ball is marginal.
Camara (POR) rests a forearm on Gafford's (DAL) body and the contact during the dunk is marginal.
Washington (DAL) removes his resting hand from Grant's (POR) body prior to the start of Grant's upward shooting motion.
Sharpe (POR) reaches for the rebound and grazes Grimes' (DAL) head.
Sharpe (POR) commits a take foul on Grimes (DAL).
Doncic (DAL) absorbs the contact initiated by Sharpe (POR) during the drive.
Doncic (DAL) initiates body contact with Avdija (POR) that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Sharpe (POR) commits a take foul on Grimes (DAL).
Grimes (DAL) legally contests Avdija's (POR) jump shot attempt.
